subject: [PATCH v3 7/7] selftests/mm: check that unauthorized MADV_PAGEOUT skips large file folios

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to check that an unauthorized caller cannot page out large file folios when performing a partial MADV_PAGEOUT operation on a private mapping. The test creates a PMD-sized shmem file and maps it in two different ways, then checks that the pages of the file remain mapped even if the advised range only partly covers the file folio. This ensures that the system behaves correctly when dealing with large files and partial page-out operations.
